nodes.name: flash_attention.rs
nodes.summary: FlashAttention-style tiled CPU attention for the mincut-gated transformer — block-wise Q/K/V tiling, online softmax, fused tiled GEMM, optional INT8 quantisation, plus multi-head and naive reference paths used to validate correctness in the slice-4 stack.
nodes.languageNotes: no_std-friendly (extern alloc); INT8 path mirrors the f32 path so accuracy can be compared directly.

nodes.name: FlashAttentionConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration struct controlling block sizes, head dim, causal masking, and softmax scale for FlashAttention.

nodes.name: OnlineSoftmaxState
nodes.summary: Streaming online-softmax accumulator that fuses running max, denominator, and weighted output to avoid materialising the full attention matrix.

nodes.name: for_head_dim
nodes.summary: Factory that returns a sensible FlashAttentionConfig tuned for a given head dimension.

nodes.name: for_long_sequence
nodes.summary: Factory returning a FlashAttentionConfig with larger tiles tuned for long-sequence workloads.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Incrementally updates the online-softmax state with a new score/value tile — preserves running max + denominator invariants.

nodes.name: tile_gemm_qk
nodes.summary: Fused tiled GEMM that multiplies a Q tile by a transposed K tile and writes scaled attention scores into the scores tile.

nodes.name: apply_causal_mask
nodes.summary: Applies a causal mask to a scores tile so future tokens are excluded from attention.

nodes.name: flash_attention_forward
nodes.summary: Main FlashAttention forward pass over f32 inputs — iterates Q/K/V tiles, runs fused GEMM + online softmax, and writes the output.

nodes.name: flash_attention_forward_i8
nodes.summary: INT8 FlashAttention forward path with per-tensor scales — same tiling/online-softmax structure as the f32 version but on quantised inputs.

nodes.name: tile_gemm_qk_i8
nodes.summary: INT8 counterpart of `tile_gemm_qk` — fused tiled Q·Kᵀ in INT8 with per-tensor scales.

nodes.name: flash_mha
nodes.summary: Multi-head wrapper around `flash_attention_forward` — strides through heads and calls the single-head forward per head.

nodes.name: naive_attention
nodes.summary: Reference (unfused, O(n²) memory) attention implementation used to validate FlashAttention correctness in tests.

nodes.name: metrics.rs

nodes.name: MemoryStats
nodes.summary: Memory-usage breakdown across hot/warm/cold KV cache tiers, with helpers for percentages and absolute memory saved.

nodes.name: QualityFeedback
nodes.summary: Single quality feedback record (PPL or accuracy) carrying timestamp and worst-tier annotation.

nodes.name: QualityMetric
nodes.summary: Aggregated quality metric with stability/improvement checks and target-comparison helpers.

nodes.name: TierMetrics
nodes.summary: Per-tier metric snapshot (hits, evictions, quality contribution) for the tiered KV cache.

nodes.name: QualityTracker
nodes.summary: Stateful tracker that ingests QualityFeedback samples, computes trends and tier-level metrics, and recommends whether the tier-boundary thresholds should adapt.

nodes.name: from_ppl
nodes.summary: Builds a QualityFeedback from a measured perplexity relative to a baseline.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Records one QualityFeedback sample into the rolling history and updates internal trend state.

nodes.name: current_metrics
nodes.summary: Computes the current aggregated quality metric across the recent history window.

nodes.name: compute_trend
nodes.summary: Computes the recent quality trend (improving/stable/regressing) from the history buffer.

nodes.name: tier_metrics
nodes.summary: Returns per-tier metric breakdown from the recent feedback history.

nodes.name: should_adapt
nodes.summary: Returns whether the current trend/quality state warrants re-tuning the tier-boundary thresholds.

nodes.name: boundary_adjustment_factor
nodes.summary: Computes a scalar adjustment factor for the hot/warm/cold tier boundary based on current trend.

nodes.name: rope.rs
nodes.summary: Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) for the mincut-gated transformer — precomputes cos/sin tables and applies positional rotation to Q/K vectors, with NTK-aware and YaRN scaling strategies for long-context extension.
nodes.languageNotes: no_std-friendly; provides both f32 and Q1.15 fixed-point apply paths for INT8 deployments.

nodes.name: RopeConfig
nodes.summary: RoPE configuration: head dim, base frequency, max precomputed sequence length, and the scaling strategy.

nodes.name: RopeScaling
nodes.summary: Enum of RoPE scaling strategies — None, Linear, NTK-Aware, and YaRN — selecting how positional frequencies stretch for long contexts.

nodes.name: RopeEmbedding
nodes.summary: Precomputed RoPE embedding tables (cos/sin per position and frequency pair) plus apply-rotation methods for f32 and Q1.15 inputs.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a RopeEmbedding from a RopeConfig — derives effective base frequency, computes per-position cos/sin tables, and stores them for fast lookup.

nodes.name: compute_effective_base
nodes.summary: Derives the effective base frequency after applying the chosen RopeScaling strategy.

nodes.name: compute_frequencies
nodes.summary: Computes the per-dimension-pair rotation frequencies given a base and scaling strategy.

nodes.name: apply_rotary_pos_emb
nodes.summary: Applies the precomputed cos/sin tables to rotate Q and K vectors in place for f32 inputs.

nodes.name: apply_rotary_pos_emb_q15
nodes.summary: Applies RoPE rotation to Q/K vectors stored in Q1.15 fixed-point — used when the transformer runs in INT8/Q1.15 quantised mode.

nodes.name: get_cos
nodes.summary: Accessor returning the cos table entry for a given position and dimension pair.

nodes.name: get_sin
nodes.summary: Accessor returning the sin table entry for a given position and dimension pair.

nodes.name: test_kv_cache_persistence_across_tiers

nodes.name: test_micro_config_full_pipeline

nodes.name: moe_bench.rs

nodes.name: benchmark_model.rs
nodes.summary: CLI example that loads a ruvllm model (real or simulated), runs token-generation benchmarks, and emits text or JSON reports with tokens/s, percentile latencies, and peak-memory metrics for the LLM serving engine.

nodes.name: coreml_backend.rs
nodes.summary: Apple CoreML/ANE inference backend for ruvllm — wraps .mlmodel/.mlpackage loading, ANE capability detection, tokenizer integration, streaming and non-streaming token generation, and compute-unit selection (CPU/GPU/ANE) for the LLM engine on Apple Silicon.
nodes.languageNotes: Conditionally compiled with #[cfg(target_os = "macos")] and falls back to a stub CoreMLBackend on non-macOS targets (the second class definition at L1609).

nodes.name: expert_cache.rs
nodes.summary: Hot/cold expert weight cache for BitNet MoE inference in ruvllm — implements LRU/LFU/adaptive eviction with affinity-aware scoring, prefetch hints, and a MoE batch scheduler to keep frequently routed experts resident in fast memory.

nodes.name: tl1_wasm.rs
nodes.summary: WASM-SIMD (v128) implementation of BitNet TL1 GEMV — packed ternary weight unpacking, int16 activation quantization, and horizontal sum reductions for in-browser LLM inference fallback.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses core::arch::wasm32 intrinsics (i16x8 ops) gated on target_arch = "wasm32" with a scalar fallback.

nodes.name: model_router.rs

nodes.summary: Semantic tool-result cache that deduplicates LLM tool calls via embedding similarity — supports exact and approximate lookup, TTL expiration, per-tool invalidation, and stats reporting to cut redundant tool-call latency in the ruvllm serving loop.

nodes.name: report.rs
nodes.summary: Evaluation reporting layer for ruvllm — aggregates correctness, economics, and harness results into markdown/JSON leaderboards and ablation comparisons for benchmarking inference quality vs cost.

nodes.name: model_card.rs
nodes.summary: HuggingFace-style model card data model and markdown serializer for ruvllm-published artifacts — captures task, framework, license, parameters, datasets, metrics, and tags with a fluent ModelCardBuilder.

nodes.name: kernels/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Compute-kernel umbrella module for ruvllm — re-exports Accelerate/NEON/ANE/attention/matmul/norm/quantized/rope kernels and exposes runtime capability detection plus an AttentionConfig used by the LLM forward pass.

nodes.name: micro_lora.rs
nodes.summary: MicroLoRA online-adaptation engine for ruvllm — low-rank adapters with NEON-SIMD forward, gradient accumulation, EWC-regularized updates, target-module selection, and serializable state for runtime fine-tuning of the LLM.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of #[cfg(target_arch = "aarch64")] NEON intrinsics; forward_simd_neon_impl is a 250-line vectorized hot path.

nodes.name: attention_fused.metal
nodes.summary: Metal compute shader implementing fused Flash Attention 2 (Q*K^T -> softmax -> *V) for Apple Silicon M4 Pro with online softmax, GQA support, causal masking, and tiled shared-memory loads to power ruvllm's GPU attention path.
nodes.languageNotes: MSL with simdgroup_matrix and vectorized half4 access; constants tuned for M4 Pro (1024 threads/threadgroup, 64-tile).

nodes.name: ruvltra_medium.rs

nodes.languageNotes: matmul_neon and flash_attention paths are #[cfg(target_arch = "aarch64")] hot kernels.

nodes.name: sona_llm.rs
nodes.summary: Sona-LLM continual learning loop that combines MicroLoRA instant adaptation, background consolidation, and deep optimization phases with multiple consolidation strategies (EWC, ensemble, quality-weighted, best) to evolve the ruvllm model online without catastrophic forgetting.

nodes.name: ste.rs
nodes.summary: Straight-Through Estimator (STE) gradient routines for Quantization-Aware Training — backward passes that propagate gradients through non-differentiable quantization ops and compute scale gradients for ruvllm's QAT pipeline.

nodes.name: quantize/mod.rs

nodes.name: reasoning_bank/mod.rs

nodes.name: BenchmarkResults

nodes.name: gemma2.rs
nodes.summary: Native Rust implementation of the Gemma2 transformer (2B/9B/27B) with sliding-window attention, logit soft-capping, and RoPE positional encoding; serves as a first-class backend for the ruvllm serving engine.
nodes.languageNotes: NEON-optimized logit_soft_cap and matrix paths; weight loading mirrors the Gemma2 reference layout for direct GGUF compatibility.

nodes.name: gguf_export.rs
nodes.summary: Serializes BitNet T1.58 ternary models to GGUF format with custom metadata, half-precision conversion, and validation, enabling distribution of trained BitNet checkpoints to standard GGUF loaders.

nodes.name: tokenizer.rs
nodes.summary: Byte-level BPE tokenizer adapted to BitNet models with special-token support and round-trip byte/token encoding used by the BitNet inference path.

nodes.name: pretrain_pipeline.rs
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the four-phase Claude-Flow pretraining pipeline (bootstrap, synthetic, reinforce, consolidate) with curriculum scheduling, quality gates, and SONA-style pattern checkpointing for self-improving model training.
nodes.languageNotes: 13 supporting structs encode the full pipeline state machine; phase results feed back into the curriculum scheduler each iteration.

nodes.name: working_memory.rs
nodes.summary: Agent working-memory subsystem combining task context, scratchpad entries with embeddings, attention weights, and cached tool results to give the serving engine short-term recall between requests.

nodes.name: swe_bench.rs
nodes.summary: SWE-bench task loader and filtering harness for evaluating ruvllm-served models on real GitHub bug-fix benchmarks, with JSONL ingest, sampling, and statistics summarization.

nodes.name: progress.rs
nodes.summary: Terminal progress-bar primitives with ETA, speed formatting, and multi-bar coordination used by the model-download hub to surface fetch progress to users.

nodes.name: norm.rs
nodes.summary: Normalization kernels (RMSNorm and LayerNorm) with hand-written NEON SIMD paths, scalar fallbacks, and batched variants — the hot-path layer normalization used by every transformer forward in the serving engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `#[cfg(target_arch = "aarch64")]` to gate ARM NEON intrinsics; scalar versions cover x86_64 and WASM.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the LoRA subsystem, re-exporting adapter, micro-LoRA, and training APIs that enable per-request low-rank adaptation during serving.

nodes.name: fused_ops.metal
nodes.summary: Apple Metal compute shaders implementing fused transformer ops (fused matmul, RMSNorm, softmax, SwiGLU) tuned for M-series GPUs to accelerate the Metal backend of the ruvllm serving engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Metal Shading Language with simdgroup_matrix intrinsics for M4 Pro tensor throughput.

nodes.name: affinity.rs
nodes.summary: Mixture-of-Experts expert-affinity tracker with NEON/AVX2-accelerated score decay, top-k routing, and frequency percentile statistics — drives expert selection for MoE serving paths.

nodes.name: paged_attention.rs
nodes.summary: Paged attention implementation with block-allocated KV cache, page-table lookups, and free-list management — enables non-contiguous KV memory for high concurrent serving throughput.

nodes.name: training_loop.rs
nodes.summary: Quantization-Aware Training trainer with calibration, per-step metrics, epoch checkpoints, and resume support — produces low-precision weights consumable by the pi_quant pipeline.

nodes.name: pi_quant.rs
nodes.summary: Pi-quant 2-bit and 3-bit weight quantization with scalar, NEON, and AVX2 paths plus packed block layouts and MSE/spectral/cosine quality metrics — the foundational compression layer used by ruvllm's quantized inference.
nodes.languageNotes: 1867 lines split into encoder, packer/unpacker, SIMD kernels, and quality-metric helpers; runtime CPU dispatch picks the fastest available path.

nodes.name: pattern_store.rs
nodes.summary: Reasoning-bank pattern store that ingests trajectories and lessons, classifies them by category, supports cosine-similarity retrieval, and prunes low-quality patterns — feeds learned reasoning back into the serving engine.

nodes.name: engine.rs
nodes.summary: Central ruvllm serving engine that submits, schedules, generates, streams, and times out inference requests; orchestrates the scheduler, KV cache manager, speculative decoder, and real-time optimizer for the LLM-serving entry point.
nodes.languageNotes: ServingEngine owns the model, draft model, scheduler, and async run loops; submit/stream/run_async expose blocking and Tokio-based APIs side by side.

nodes.name: speculative.rs
nodes.summary: Speculative decoding implementation with draft/verify phases, tree-of-thoughts speculation, adaptive lookahead, atomic acceptance statistics, and NEON-optimized softmax/sampling helpers used by the serving engine for throughput speedups.

nodes.name: contrastive.rs
nodes.summary: Contrastive training loop for agent embeddings with triplet and InfoNCE losses, used to learn affinity-aware representations that downstream MoE routing and reasoning-bank retrieval consume.

nodes.name: adapter_integration.rs
nodes.summary: Integration tests exercising LoRA adapter swapping and MicroLoRA per-request adaptation against the serving engine to validate end-to-end adapter lifecycle.

nodes.name: perplexity_baselines.json
nodes.summary: Reference perplexity, repetition, coherence, speed, and memory baselines for quantized model regression tests, gating ruvllm releases against quality drift.

nodes.name: pi_quant_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit and property tests for pi-quant 2-bit and 3-bit kernels, validating pack/unpack round-trips and SIMD/scalar parity to guard the inference quantization layer.

nodes.name: ModelDef
nodes.summary: Defines a downloadable test model with HuggingFace coordinates and expected size for the example loader.

nodes.name: AtomicSpeculativeStats

nodes.name: softmax_neon_optimized
nodes.summary: NEON-vectorized softmax used by the sampling step of speculative verification.

nodes.name: top_p_filter
nodes.summary: Nucleus (top-p) sampling filter applied to verified token distributions.

nodes.name: ContrastiveTrainer
nodes.summary: Contrastive training driver computing triplet and InfoNCE losses over agent embeddings to learn affinity-aware representations.

nodes.name: ContrastiveConfig

nodes.name: Cargo.toml

nodes.languageNotes: Multi-feature Cargo manifest with macOS-only conditional dependencies (objc2/Metal) and three benchmark targets.

nodes.name: pi_quant_bench.rs
nodes.summary: Criterion benchmark suite for the PI quantization codec (Pi3BitBlock, Pi2BitBlock) measuring pack/unpack throughput, scalar vs SIMD performance, and STE variants used by the BitNet/PI-quant inference path.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of criterion::black_box and parameterized BenchmarkGroup across multiple bit-width formats.

nodes.name: generate_claude_dataset.rs
nodes.summary: Example binary that materializes a Claude-style training/evaluation dataset and prints statistics, sample exemplars, and model-routing analysis used to seed the reasoning bank and GRPO training loops.

nodes.name: hybrid_pipeline.rs
nodes.summary: Hybrid CPU/Metal/ANE execution pipeline that routes each transformer operation (flash attention, MLP, RMSNorm, RoPE) to the optimal accelerator on Apple Silicon and records per-accelerator utilization metrics for the LLM serving stack.
nodes.languageNotes: Trait-based dispatch with AcceleratorType enum and runtime capability detection; ZeroCopy tensor representation between CPU and GPU memory.

nodes.name: HybridPipeline
nodes.summary: Central dispatcher that holds Metal and ANE backend handles, exposes flash_attention/mlp_forward/rms_norm/apply_rope, and selects an accelerator per operation based on the configured AneStrategy.

nodes.name: AcceleratorMetrics
nodes.summary: Per-accelerator counter struct tracking operation counts, total bytes processed, and aggregate latency for utilization summaries.

nodes.name: HybridTensor
nodes.summary: Zero-copy tensor wrapper that can live in CPU or accelerator memory and transitions between formats without redundant copies.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: BitNet b1.58 module root that wires together ternary quantization, GGUF export, tokenizer, expert cache, TL1 kernels (AVX2/WASM/scalar), and trace utilities used by the multiplication-free inference path.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust barrel module that conditionally compiles TL1 SIMD kernels per target_arch (x86_64+avx2, wasm32).

nodes.name: trace.rs
nodes.summary: Structured tracing facility for BitNet inference that captures routing decisions, citations, refusals, and stop reasons into JSONL files for offline evaluation and routing-agreement analysis.

nodes.name: TraceWriter
nodes.summary: Buffered JSONL trace writer that records BitNet inference events, supports flushing and clearing, and exposes Jaccard similarity helpers to compare routing decisions across runs.

nodes.name: TraceEntry
nodes.summary: Serializable record describing a single BitNet inference event with routing, citation, refusal, and stop-reason payloads.

nodes.name: reasoning_bank.rs
nodes.summary: Claude-flow ReasoningBank that records trajectories, distills repeatable patterns, and emits routing recommendations against the SONA memory layer to feed in-context learning and online GRPO updates.
nodes.languageNotes: Bridges the local reasoning bank with sona vector memory; provides preset configs (for_ruvltra_small, for_edge).

nodes.name: ReasoningBankIntegration
nodes.summary: Top-level facade combining trajectory recording, SONA storage, pattern distillation, recommendation lookup, consolidation, and pattern import/export for the Claude-flow loop.

nodes.name: Trajectory
nodes.summary: Sequence of TrajectoryStep entries representing one reasoning episode with task-type tagging and quality scoring.

nodes.name: DistilledPattern
nodes.summary: Generalized template extracted from successful trajectories, scored for similarity, used to recommend the best agent for new inputs and pruned when stale.

nodes.name: error.rs
nodes.summary: Central RuvLLMError enum (thiserror-based) covering quantization, GGUF, Metal, ANE, KV-cache, training, and IO failure modes used across the entire ruvllm crate.

nodes.name: RuvLLMError
nodes.summary: Unified error enum for the ruvllm crate with thiserror display impls; consumed by every other module via Result aliases.

nodes.name: loader.rs
nodes.summary: GGUF model loader with mmap, layer/tensor filtering, streaming weight loading, and TensorNameMapper that converts upstream GGUF tensor names into ruvllm backend names for inference startup.
nodes.languageNotes: Supports both eager LoadedWeights and incremental StreamingLoader for low-memory environments.

nodes.name: GgufLoader
nodes.summary: Primary GGUF loader exposing architecture detection, model_config, tensor info enumeration, and bulk/per-layer weight loading.

nodes.name: StreamingLoader
nodes.summary: Stateful layer-by-layer GGUF loader for memory-constrained inference that progresses through embeddings, transformer layers, and the output head sequentially.

nodes.name: LoadedWeights
nodes.summary: In-memory container of fully loaded tensors with lookup by name, layer, category, and architecture metadata.

nodes.name: registry.rs
nodes.summary: RuvLtra model registry that catalogs available base models and adapters by size and quantization level, with hardware-requirement filtering and HuggingFace download URL resolution.

nodes.name: RuvLtraRegistry
nodes.summary: Singleton-style registry exposing get/list_by_size/list_base_models/list_adapters/recommend_for_ram lookups over RuvLtra ModelInfo entries.

nodes.name: ModelInfo
nodes.summary: Catalog entry describing a RuvLtra model variant with size, quantization, hardware requirements, and download URL helpers.

nodes.name: quantized.rs
nodes.summary: Quantized arithmetic kernels (INT8, INT4, GGUF Q4_K block) including quantize/dequantize routines and NEON-accelerated GEMV used by the inference path on ARM hosts.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-rolled NEON intrinsics for matrix-vector multiplication of INT8, INT4 and BlockQ4K layouts.

nodes.name: BlockQ4K
nodes.summary: GGUF Q4_K super-block representation (32-element groups with per-group scales/mins) used by int4 GEMV kernels.

nodes.name: training.rs

nodes.name: TrainingPipeline

nodes.name: GradientAccumulator

nodes.name: gemm.metal

nodes.languageNotes: Uses metal_simdgroup_matrix and bank-conflict-free padded shared memory; explicit security fix lowered tile size to stay under 32KB threadgroup limit.

nodes.name: metrics.rs
nodes.summary: Mixture-of-Experts metrics collector tracking expert cache hit/miss rates, paging events, routing latency, prefetch accuracy, and affinity eviction counters with summary aggregation.

nodes.name: MoeMetrics

nodes.name: policy_store.rs

nodes.name: PolicyStore
nodes.summary: Top-level CRUD facade for semantic policy entries with type-filtered search and helpers to store quantization and router policies.

nodes.name: RouterPolicy

nodes.name: CoherenceValidator

nodes.name: CoherenceConfig

nodes.name: pi_quant_simd.rs
nodes.summary: SIMD-accelerated PI quantization codec (pi-3 / pi-2 bit-packed formats) with NEON, AVX2, AVX-512, and scalar fallbacks for the encode/decode hot path on every supported architecture.

nodes.summary: In-crate unit tests validating SiLU, GELU, and related activation kernels against reference implementations to guard the inference engine's elementwise math.

nodes.name: ane_test_utils.rs

nodes.name: e2e_bench.rs
nodes.summary: End-to-end Criterion benchmarks for LLM serving covering single/multi-layer forward passes, KV-cache ops, decode throughput, prefill latency, and tokens-per-second estimation across Llama2/Llama3/Mistral configurations.
nodes.languageNotes: Criterion-based Rust microbenchmarks with model-sized configurations to estimate realistic serving throughput.

nodes.name: ModelConfig
nodes.summary: Holds reference dimensions for common open-source models (Llama2-7B/13B, Llama3-8B, Mistral-7B) used to parameterize benchmarks.

nodes.name: TransformerLayer
nodes.summary: Bench-only transformer-layer shim that performs a single-token forward pass using simple GEMV, RoPE, and attention helpers to estimate serving cost.

nodes.name: KvCache
nodes.summary: Simple growing KV cache used by the benchmark transformer layer to measure cache-append and memory growth patterns.

nodes.name: forward_single_token
nodes.summary: Runs one decode step (Q/K/V projection, RoPE, attention, output, FFN, residual) to model per-token serving latency for the benchmark suite.

nodes.name: bench_decode_throughput
nodes.summary: Measures tokens-per-second decode throughput across model sizes — a primary LLM-serving SLO.

nodes.name: bench_prefill_latency
nodes.summary: Measures prefill latency for variable prompt lengths, modeling the time-to-first-token cost of LLM serving.

nodes.name: bench_kv_cache_operations
nodes.summary: Times KV-cache append and read operations at varying context lengths to characterize memory traffic during serving.

nodes.name: bench_inference_components
nodes.summary: Micro-benchmarks individual inference primitives (GEMV, RoPE, attention) to attribute serving cost to specific kernels.

nodes.name: turbo_quant_bench.rs
nodes.summary: Criterion benchmarks for the TurboQuant compressed-vector subsystem covering compress/decompress throughput, inner-product accuracy, cache tiers, KV-cache, embedding store, and dimension scaling — sized to LLM-serving memory budgets.

nodes.name: bench_compress_throughput
nodes.summary: Times TurboQuant vector compression at varying bit widths to characterize the encode-side cost of serving-time quantization.

nodes.name: bench_kv_cache
nodes.summary: Benchmarks the TurboQuant-backed KV cache path used during serving — push/get/decompress at realistic context lengths.

nodes.name: bench_embedding_store
nodes.summary: Times compressed-embedding-store build/get/search to measure retrieval-augmented serving footprint.

nodes.name: bench_memory_efficiency
nodes.summary: Reports memory compression ratios across TurboQuant bit widths versus fp32 baselines for capacity-planning the serving footprint.

nodes.name: bench_dimension_scaling
nodes.summary: Sweeps embedding dimension to characterize how compressed inner-product cost scales with the model hidden size used at serving time.

nodes.name: ruvltra_small.json
nodes.summary: Model card / architecture descriptor for the RuvLTRA-Small 0.5B LLM (Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct base), declaring hidden size, attention heads, RoPE theta, GQA layout, and SoNA/ANE optimization flags consumed by the serving runtime.

nodes.name: TEST_COVERAGE.md
nodes.summary: Test-coverage report for the PT-BitNet b1.58 quantizer (ADR-017 Phase 0): 61 tests across 8 categories covering ternary packing, absmean quantization, dequantization, tensors, layer filtering, and edge cases used to validate serving-grade compressed weights.

nodes.name: ternary_tensor.rs
nodes.summary: Ternary tensor type for BitNet b1.58 — packs values from {-1, 0, +1} into 2-bit fields with per-tensor scale, providing the in-memory representation used during compressed LLM serving.

nodes.name: TernaryTensor
nodes.summary: 2-bit packed ternary weight tensor with shape and FP32 scale; exposes sparsity, memory footprint, and block count for serving-time accounting.

nodes.name: pack_ternary
nodes.summary: Packs a slice of {-1, 0, +1} weights into 2-bit codes (00, 01, 10) for compact storage of BitNet weights served at runtime.

nodes.name: unpack_ternary
nodes.summary: Decodes 2-bit packed ternary weights back into i8 values for use in BitNet inference kernels during serving.

nodes.name: flow_optimizer.rs
nodes.summary: Trains the SoNA router to pick the right agent / model tier per task using labeled samples, used to optimize routing decisions inside the ruvllm serving stack.

nodes.name: FlowOptimizer
nodes.summary: Trains a SoNA-based routing policy by recording a baseline, ingesting (task, embedding, correct_agent, success) samples, and reporting accuracy improvements.

nodes.name: OptimizationConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for FlowOptimizer training runs: target accuracy, max training time, and sample budget for routing model fitting.

nodes.name: OptimizationResult
nodes.summary: Result record summarizing baseline vs. final routing accuracy, training samples used, and per-agent improvement for SoNA optimization.

nodes.name: ClaudeFlowMemoryBridge

nodes.name: ClaudeFlowBridgeConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the claude-flow bridge: CLI binary path, default namespace, cache TTL, and retry behavior.

nodes.name: sync_with_hive

nodes.name: execute_cli

nodes.name: EvalReport

nodes.name: quantization.rs
nodes.summary: GGUF tensor dequantization for the full llama.cpp quant matrix (Q4_0..Q6_K, IQ4_NL, BitNet T1.58, BF16) — required to load quantized weights at serving time.

nodes.name: GgufQuantType
nodes.summary: Exhaustive enum of GGUF tensor quantization types with block size, type size, and tensor-size accessors mirroring the llama.cpp format.

nodes.name: QuantizedTensor
nodes.summary: Wraps raw GGUF bytes plus a quant type and element count, exposing block_count and a typed dequantize() entry point.

nodes.name: dequantize_tensor
nodes.summary: Top-level dispatcher that decodes a GGUF buffer of the requested quant type into an FP32 tensor consumed by serving kernels.

nodes.name: dequantize_q4_k
nodes.summary: Decodes Q4_K super-blocks (4-bit weights with 6-bit scales/mins) into FP32 — the most common quantization for served models.

nodes.name: dequantize_q6_k
nodes.summary: Decodes Q6_K super-blocks into FP32 for higher-precision serving when bandwidth allows it.

nodes.name: dequantize_bitnet_t158_wrapper
nodes.summary: Decodes the project-specific BitNet T1.58 layout from a GGUF buffer into FP32 for serving BitNet weights.

nodes.name: activations.rs
nodes.summary: Activation kernels (SiLU/GELU/ReLU/LeakyReLU/Softmax) with scalar reference and AArch64 NEON SIMD paths used in transformer FFN/attention during LLM serving.
nodes.languageNotes: Mix of scalar fallbacks and explicit NEON intrinsics for Apple Silicon serving.

nodes.name: silu
nodes.summary: Element-wise SiLU (x * sigmoid(x)) used in Llama/Mistral SwiGLU FFNs during decode.

nodes.name: gelu
nodes.summary: Element-wise GELU activation (tanh approximation) used by GPT-style FFNs at serving time.

nodes.name: softmax
nodes.summary: Numerically stable softmax used in attention probability normalization during decode.

nodes.name: softmax_neon_impl
nodes.summary: NEON-vectorized softmax for Apple Silicon serving paths — fuses max-subtract, exp, sum, and divide.

nodes.name: exp_neon
nodes.summary: Polynomial NEON approximation of exp(x) used to vectorize sigmoid/softmax/GELU during serving.

nodes.name: adapter.rs
nodes.summary: LoRA adapter runtime: registry, pool, and composer that dynamically loads/unloads micro-LoRA adapters and composes them (sequential, weighted, task-routed) during multi-tenant LLM serving.

nodes.name: AdapterRegistry
nodes.summary: Memory-bounded registry of LoRA adapters with capacity eviction; the canonical source of truth for adapter instances served at runtime.

nodes.name: AdapterPool
nodes.summary: Acquire/release pool that hands out shared adapter handles to serving requests without re-instantiating weights.

nodes.name: AdapterComposer
nodes.summary: Composes multiple LoRAs at inference time using Average, Weighted, Sequential, TaskRouted, or Interpolated strategies for adapter mixing.

nodes.name: AdapterHandle
nodes.summary: Reference-counted handle wrapping an adapter with acquire/release semantics for safe sharing across serving threads.

nodes.name: CompositionStrategy
nodes.summary: Enum selecting how multiple adapters combine (Average, Weighted, Sequential, TaskRouted, Interpolated).

nodes.name: ensure_capacity
nodes.summary: Eviction loop that frees memory in the adapter registry when serving more tenants than capacity allows.

nodes.name: metal/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Metal-backend entry point for ruvllm: parameter structs for attention/GEMM/norm/RoPE kernels (including paged and YaRN variants) plus device-info gating used to dispatch Apple Silicon serving kernels.

nodes.name: AttentionParams
nodes.summary: Plain-old-data struct of attention shape and scale parameters passed to the Metal attention kernel.

nodes.name: RopeAttentionParams
nodes.summary: Parameter struct for the fused RoPE-then-Attention kernel including position offset and theta, used during decode serving.

nodes.name: YarnAttentionParams
nodes.summary: YaRN-scaled RoPE attention parameters supporting context-window extension at serving time.

nodes.name: PagedAttentionParams
nodes.summary: PagedAttention parameter struct (block_size, num_pages) for vLLM-style block-paged KV cache on Metal.

nodes.name: FusedAttentionParams
nodes.summary: Parameters for the fused-QKV attention kernel that combines projection + scaled dot-product + softmax for serving decode steps.

nodes.name: GemmParams
nodes.summary: MxNxK GEMM shape struct passed to the Metal matmul kernel used by all linear projections in serving.

nodes.name: NormParams
nodes.summary: RMSNorm / LayerNorm parameter struct for the Metal normalization kernel.

nodes.name: RopeParams
nodes.summary: RoPE rotary-embedding parameter struct shared with the rope.metal kernel.

nodes.name: QuantParams
nodes.summary: Parameters for the Metal int-quant decompression kernel used to feed weight values into matmul on-device.

nodes.name: get_device_info
nodes.summary: Returns Metal device capabilities (M-series tier, memory, MPS support) used to gate kernel selection at serving time.

nodes.name: rope.metal
nodes.summary: Apple Silicon Metal compute shader implementing Rotary Position Embeddings with precomputed sin/cos tables, batch processing, and vectorized memory access for transformer attention during LLM serving.
nodes.languageNotes: Metal Shading Language with `kernel` entry points, constant-memory tables, and SIMD-group primitives — included as a string blob and dispatched by the Rust Metal pipeline.

nodes.name: sram_mapper.rs
nodes.summary: Mixture-of-Experts SRAM/DRAM/NVMe tier mapper that decides which experts live in fast on-chip SRAM versus paged tiers based on router weights and access frequency — central to MoE serving throughput.

nodes.name: SramMapper
nodes.summary: Owns expert-to-tier assignments, tracks access counters, and recommends tier changes to keep hot experts in SRAM during serving.

nodes.name: MemoryTier
nodes.summary: Enum of expert storage tiers (SRAM, DRAM, NVMe) with names and ordering for the MoE serving hierarchy.

nodes.name: HardwareConfig
nodes.summary: Hardware budget descriptor (SRAM bytes, DRAM bytes, expert size) used to compute the per-tier expert slot count.

nodes.name: HardwarePreset
nodes.summary: Built-in presets for common Apple Silicon / NVIDIA tiers that yield a calibrated HardwareConfig for MoE serving.

nodes.name: SramExpertAffinity
nodes.summary: Per-expert tracking record with access count, recency, router weight, and priority score used by the SRAM mapper.

nodes.name: suggest_tier_changes
nodes.summary: Compares current vs. ideal expert tiers using priority scores and yields promotion/demotion suggestions for the serving loop.

nodes.name: record_access
nodes.summary: Updates per-expert access counters and EMA of router weights from each forward pass to feed tier-change decisions.

nodes.name: distillation.rs
nodes.summary: Quantization-aware-training knowledge-distillation loss combining task cross-entropy with KL divergence against a teacher's soft targets — used to recover quality of compressed weights served in production.

nodes.name: DistillationLoss
nodes.summary: Stateful loss combiner that mixes task CE and temperature-scaled KD KL terms with configurable weighting and tracks training stats.

nodes.name: DistillationConfig
nodes.summary: Configurable distillation hyperparameters (temperature, alpha balance, focus profile) with reasoning-focused and compression-focused presets.

nodes.name: TeacherOutput
nodes.summary: Holds teacher logits and cached softmax probabilities consumed by the distillation loss across training steps.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Computes combined task + KD loss for one step, blending student logits with teacher soft targets and labels.

nodes.name: compute_kd_loss
nodes.summary: Temperature-scaled KL-divergence loss between student and teacher softmaxes — the distillation signal that recovers quantized-serving accuracy.

nodes.name: scoring_engine.rs
nodes.summary: Quality scoring engine that grades served generations across schema compliance, semantic coherence, diversity, and temporal realism, with trend tracking and improvement recommendations for online LLM serving.

nodes.name: QualityScoringEngine
nodes.summary: Main engine that scores GenerationResults, maintains rolling quality history, analyzes trends, and suggests actionable improvements to the serving pipeline.

nodes.name: ScoringConfig
nodes.summary: Weights and thresholds for the four quality dimensions plus history-window size used by the scoring engine.

nodes.name: TrendAnalysis
nodes.summary: Rolling trend summary (slope, mean, std dev) of quality dimensions over a serving window.

nodes.name: ImprovementRecommendation
nodes.summary: Actionable recommendation record (dimension, severity, suggested fix) emitted when quality drops below thresholds in serving.

nodes.name: score_generation
nodes.summary: Scores a full GenerationResult emitted by the serving stack across all configured quality dimensions.

nodes.name: improvement_recommendations
nodes.summary: Inspects metrics against thresholds and produces remediation suggestions (e.g., adjust temperature, tighten schema) for the serving operator.

nodes.name: visualize_trends
nodes.summary: Renders an ASCII trend chart of quality history for quick operator dashboards over the serving window.

nodes.name: turbo_quant.rs
nodes.summary: TurboQuant — Hadamard-rotated scalar quantization with KV cache, multi-tier cache, and embedding-store front-ends that achieves 4-32x compression while preserving inner-product accuracy for compressed LLM serving.

nodes.name: TurboQuantCompressor
nodes.summary: Main compressor that rotates vectors through Hadamard space and quantizes them, with fast asymmetric inner-product paths used at serving time.

nodes.name: TurboQuantBits
nodes.summary: Enum selecting bit width (Bits1 through Bits8) with helpers for scalar levels, effective bits, and compression ratios vs fp32/fp16.

nodes.name: TurboQuantConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for TurboQuant compression (bits, block size, Hadamard seed, dim padding).

nodes.name: TurboQuantized
nodes.summary: Compressed-batch container with packed codes, per-block scales/offsets, and memory/compression accounting served alongside the runtime.

nodes.name: TurboQuantKvPair
nodes.summary: Compressed K/V pair record used by the TurboQuant KV cache during decode serving.

nodes.name: TurboQuantCacheTier
nodes.summary: Cache tier that stores TurboQuant-compressed vectors with promotion/eviction stats for serving capacity planning.

nodes.name: TurboQuantEmbeddingStore
nodes.summary: ID-keyed compressed embedding store with batch build, get, and top-k search used by RAG-style serving paths.

nodes.name: compress_batch
nodes.summary: Compresses a batch of FP32 vectors through Hadamard rotation and per-block scalar quantization, returning a TurboQuantized buffer.

nodes.name: decompress
nodes.summary: Reconstructs FP32 vectors from a TurboQuantized buffer for paths that require dequantized inputs at serving time.

nodes.name: inner_product_asymmetric_optimized
nodes.summary: Fast FP32-query / compressed-database inner product used to retrieve top-K embeddings during retrieval-augmented serving.

nodes.name: dot_in_rotated_space
nodes.summary: Computes a dot product directly in the Hadamard-rotated quantized space, avoiding full decompression in the hot serving path.

nodes.name: reflection/mod.rs

nodes.name: session.rs

nodes.name: SessionManager
nodes.summary: Owns the live session map, enforces max_sessions, expires idle sessions, and exposes create/get/update/terminate APIs to the serving frontend.

nodes.name: Session

nodes.name: SessionConfig
nodes.summary: Session-manager configuration (max sessions, idle timeout, KV-cache budgets) consumed at serving startup.

nodes.name: SessionStatus

nodes.name: SessionMetadata

nodes.name: create_session

nodes.name: cleanup_expired
nodes.summary: Sweeps idle sessions past the timeout and reclaims their KV-cache memory — invoked by the serving housekeeping loop.

nodes.name: simd_equivalence_tests.rs
nodes.summary: ADR-090 / INV-8 SIMD-equivalence test suite proving NEON / AVX2 / WASM SIMD128 kernels match scalar references within <=1 ULP — a correctness invariant the serving runtime depends on.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bit-level ULP comparisons rather than epsilon tolerance — the strictest possible numerical equivalence check.

nodes.name: lora_bench.rs
nodes.summary: Criterion benchmark suite measuring LoRA adapter forward/backward performance, SIMD-vectorized projection, gradient accumulation with EWC regularization, and multi-adapter scaling for online RL fine-tuning of the ruvllm serving stack.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Criterion harness with target-feature gating (aarch64 NEON / x86_64 AVX2) for SIMD paths.

nodes.name: GITHUB_ISSUE_MISTRAL_RS.md
nodes.summary: Tracking GitHub issue specifying the full mistral-rs backend integration plan for ruvllm — PagedAttention, X-LoRA dynamic adapter routing, and in-situ quantization (ISQ) to lift throughput from ~100 tok/s to 500-1000 tok/s for production LLM serving.

nodes.name: adapter_manager.rs
nodes.summary: Runtime manager for LoRA adapter lifecycle in the LLM serving engine — handles loading, hot-swapping, applying low-rank updates to base weights, and enforcing memory budgets across concurrently-loaded adapters.

nodes.name: backend.rs
nodes.summary: Core BitNet 1.58-bit ternary inference backend for ruvllm — implements GGUF model loading, tensor name mapping, MLA/GQA attention forward passes with KV caching, MoE expert routing, RoPE/YaRN scaling, and TL1 lookup-table dequantization for ultra-low-bit LLM serving.
nodes.languageNotes: 4691-line monolith implementing the full BitNet forward graph; uses TL1 LUTs for dequant and supports MLA-style compressed KV caches.

nodes.name: tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests covering the BitNet ternary quantization/dequantization roundtrip, tensor block packing, sparsity calculation, layer-mask quantize policy, and edge-case handling (subnormal, NaN, infinity, very-large) for the 1.58-bit inference path.

nodes.name: hnsw_router.rs
nodes.summary: HNSW-based semantic router that picks an LLM serving handler by k-NN similarity over learned task-embedding patterns — tracks per-pattern success rates, consolidates duplicates, prunes stale entries, and falls back to a hybrid rule+HNSW router for cold paths.

nodes.name: context_manager.rs
nodes.summary: Intelligent prompt-context assembler that scores, prioritizes, and summarizes memories plus history under a per-model token budget, producing the final context window passed to ruvllm inference.

nodes.name: metrics.rs
nodes.summary: Aggregator that collects per-request inference metrics (latency, tokens, success/failure) and produces percentile-based statistics for evaluating ruvllm serving quality.

nodes.name: tensors.rs
nodes.summary: Parses GGUF tensor metadata into typed records (attention, FFN, embedding, norm, expert) and exposes per-layer lookup helpers used by the ruvllm GGUF loader to populate the BitNet/transformer inference graph.

nodes.name: ane_ops.rs
nodes.summary: Apple Neural Engine (ANE) compute kernels — wraps BNNS/BNNSGraph for batched matmul, layer/RMS norm, GELU/SiLU and softmax with availability checks and auto-fallback to CPU paths, accelerating ruvllm inference on Apple Silicon.
nodes.languageNotes: FFI wrappers around Apple's BNNS/BNNSGraph C APIs; gated by target_os=macos and runtime ANE availability checks.

nodes.name: merge.rs
nodes.summary: Implements multi-adapter merging strategies (average, weighted, SLERP, TIES, DARE) plus hot-swap management so ruvllm can compose or switch LoRA adapters during serving without reloading the base model.

nodes.name: operations.rs
nodes.summary: High-level Metal GPU operation wrappers for ruvllm — batched GEMM/GEMV (FP16/INT8), fused attention with KV cache, layer norm, fused MLP, chunked attention, and speculative-decode verification kernels for Apple Silicon inference.

nodes.name: rope_attention.metal
nodes.summary: Metal compute shader fusing RoPE (with YaRN/NTK scaling) directly into the attention QK matmul on Apple M4 Pro, reducing memory traffic by avoiding intermediate Q/K materialization during ruvllm LLM serving.
nodes.languageNotes: Metal Shading Language using metal_simdgroup_matrix and half2 vector ops; 1024 threads per threadgroup.

nodes.name: metrics.rs
nodes.summary: Real-time inference metrics core for ruvllm — moving averages, latency histograms with percentiles, TTFT/TPS trend tracking, KV-cache hit rate, and snapshot collection for the serving optimization loop.

nodes.name: lora_qat.rs
nodes.summary: Quantization-Aware Training pipeline for LoRA adapters used by ruvllm — forward/backward with straight-through fake-quant, configurable bitwidth, and weight-merging utilities so trained low-bit adapters can be deployed without quality cliff.

nodes.name: validators.rs
nodes.summary: Composable output validators for ruvllm responses — JSON-schema, type, range, format (regex/enum/email/etc), and combined check pipelines to gate generated content before it is returned to clients.

nodes.name: turboquant_profile.rs
nodes.summary: Loads TurboQuant profile TOML files describing per-layer bitwidth and group-size policies, discovers profiles on disk, and converts them into runtime quantization configs consumed by ruvllm's serving stack.

nodes.name: perspectives.rs
nodes.summary: Multi-perspective self-critique layer — correctness, completeness, and consistency checkers each critique a ruvllm response and merge their findings into a unified critique that the reflective agent loop uses to refine outputs.

nodes.name: session_index.rs
nodes.summary: Index that maps ruvllm session metadata into a searchable store keyed by context fingerprint, enabling KV-cache reuse and session-aware prompt assembly across requests.

nodes.name: witness_log_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the witness-log audit subsystem — verifies latency breakdown math, routing-decision (de)serialization, async writeback batching/backpressure, concurrent entry creation, and quality/error metadata on ruvllm inference events.

nodes.name: tool_dataset.rs
nodes.summary: Synthetic tool-calling dataset generator — defines an MCP tool catalog across categories, samples difficulty levels, and emits JSONL success/error examples used to fine-tune ruvllm models for agentic tool use.
nodes.languageNotes: Single 2146-line file; `define_mcp_tools` spans ~1200 lines as a static tool-catalog builder.

nodes.name: cross_platform_v21.rs
nodes.summary: Integration tests exercising ruvllm's v2.1 cross-platform capability detection — platform/architecture/CPU-feature/GPU-capability probing plus fallback-chain resolution across x86_64+AVX2, Apple M-series Metal, CUDA, WebGPU, and WASM serving targets.

nodes.name: lora_integration.rs
nodes.summary: Integration tests covering the end-to-end LoRA path in ruvllm — micro-LoRA adapt/forward/reset, gradient accumulation, multi-rank configurations, SIMD forward parity, target-module variants, and save/load round-trip.

nodes.name: sona_integration.rs
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the Sona learning loop in ruvllm — trajectory recording, quality thresholds, transform application, background/deep optimization loops, routing recommendations, and concurrency safety of the self-organizing meta-learner.

nodes.name: matmul_bench.rs
nodes.summary: Criterion benchmark suite for ruvllm's matrix-multiplication kernels (GEMV, GEMM, batched GEMM, GEMM-NT, dot product) including NEON SIMD versus scalar fallbacks across realistic LLM projection sizes. Used to measure the throughput of attention and FFN linear layers driving inference performance.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses inline aarch64 NEON intrinsics with #[target_feature(enable = "neon")] for hand-tuned GEMV/GEMM paths.

nodes.name: GITHUB_ISSUE_SOTA_FEATURES.md
nodes.summary: GitHub issue draft proposing SOTA features (structured JSON output, speculative decoding, prefix caching, etc.) for production agentic LLM workflows served by ruvllm. Describes motivation, API sketches, and rollout plan for closing the gap with vLLM/TGI.

nodes.name: autodetect.rs
nodes.summary: Runtime hardware introspection layer that fingerprints platform, architecture, CPU features (AVX2/NEON/F16C), GPU/Metal/CUDA/WebGPU presence, core topology, ANE, and memory, then recommends optimal compute backend, batch size, quantization, and inference config for ruvllm.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses cfg(target_arch) feature flags and runtime CPUID/sysctl probes to keep the binary portable across macOS Apple Silicon, Linux x86_64, and Windows.

nodes.name: dequantize.rs
nodes.summary: Reference dequantizer for BitNet b1.58 ternary tensors, producing FP32 reconstructions and measuring quantization error. Used to validate the BitNet TL1 packed-weight format that powers ruvllm's 1.58-bit inference path.

nodes.name: tl1_avx2.rs
nodes.summary: AVX2 GEMV kernel for BitNet TL1 packed ternary weights, including i16 activation quantization, packed-index unpacking, and a scalar fallback. Provides the x86 hot path for 1.58-bit matrix-vector multiplies during inference.
nodes.languageNotes: Gated on cfg(target_arch = "x86_64") with #[target_feature(enable = "avx2")] for fine-grained dispatch.

nodes.name: hooks_integration.rs
nodes.summary: Implements ruvllm's Claude-Flow hook surface (pre/post task, pre/post edit, session lifecycle) that routes agent work between ruvllm and external agent-booster backends and records trajectories for Sona learning loops.

nodes.name: episodic_memory.rs
nodes.summary: Long-horizon episodic memory store for LLM context — stores compressed embedding+text episodes with metadata, supports similarity search, filtered retrieval, age-based compression, and capacity enforcement to augment generation with retrieved past episodes.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for ruvllm's evaluation harness — re-exports correctness, diff-quality, economics, metrics, real-harness, report, and SWE-bench submodules used to score generations from inference runs.

nodes.name: download.rs
nodes.summary: Model-hub downloader that validates URLs and repo IDs, canonicalizes destination paths to guard against traversal, then fetches model weights via curl/wget with checksum verification and human-readable progress reporting.

nodes.name: attention.rs
nodes.summary: Core attention kernel library for ruvllm — Flash-Attention v2 (NEON and scalar), paged/multi-query/grouped-query/multi-head attention, KV-cache management with paged blocks, and tiled batched score plus softmax routines. The hot path that dominates LLM decoding latency.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes aarch64 NEON intrinsics with scalar fallbacks and Rayon parallelism; PagedKvCache holds block-based K/V buffers for vLLM-style serving.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Public surface for ruvllm's LoRA adapter system — wraps RuvLtraAdapters registry, LoraConfig and its builder, AdapterMetadata, and delegates to merge/trainer/micro_lora submodules for per-domain adapter swapping at inference time.

nodes.name: pipelines.rs
nodes.summary: Apple Metal compute-pipeline cache and shader generator — compiles GEMM/attention MSL shaders on demand, caches pipeline objects keyed by config, and reports available Metal optimizations (simdgroup matrices, fp16, etc.) for Apple Silicon inference.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel for ruvllm's first-party model definitions, re-exporting the ruvltra and ruvltra_medium architectures used as default backends when no external model is loaded.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel for the runtime optimization subsystem (metrics, realtime tuner, Sona-LLM feedback) that adjusts inference parameters under load based on live telemetry.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) module surface — wires calibration, config, differentiable quantizers, distillation, LoRA-QAT, reasoning-loss, straight-through estimators, and the training loop used to fine-tune low-bit checkpoints before serving.

nodes.name: hadamard.rs
nodes.summary: Hadamard rotation transform (QuaRot/SpinQuant style) for outlier-suppression prior to weight/activation quantization — implements scalar, NEON, and AVX2 butterfly kernels, sign application, normalization, and batch forward/inverse passes.

nodes.name: consolidation.rs
nodes.summary: Reasoning-pattern consolidator implementing Fisher-information-weighted EWC-style merging — collapses similar trajectory patterns, computes regularization losses, and adapts lambda to avoid catastrophic forgetting in ruvllm's reasoning bank.

nodes.name: reflective_agent.rs
nodes.summary: Reflexion-style reflective agent wrapper that re-executes an LLM task with structured self-critique on failure — manages reflection strategy, confidence scoring, error recovery, and multi-perspective retries while feeding outcomes back to the reasoning bank.

nodes.name: integration.rs
nodes.summary: Sona-LLM integration adapter — records inference trajectories, runs instant/background/deep self-improvement loops, computes pseudo-gradients, exposes routing recommendations, and exports learned policy back into the witness-log/policy-store.

nodes.name: tokenizer.rs
nodes.summary: Tokenizer and chat-template layer — detects format from model id (Llama3, Llama2, Mistral, ChatML, Phi, Gemma, custom), formats prompts accordingly, and provides a streaming decode buffer for incremental detokenization during generation.

nodes.name: types.rs

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for the L6 venue-agnostic strategy crate; declares neural-trader-strategies, ties together neural-trader-core / coherence / ruvector-attention dependencies, and configures benchmarks/tests for the EV-Kelly, AttentionScalper, CoherenceArb strategies and the RiskGate.

nodes.name: attention_scalper.rs
nodes.summary: Multi-level order-book imbalance scalper that consumes MarketEvent::BookSnapshot and emits buy/sell Intents; supports two imbalance modes (geometric decay, default; or ruvector-attention ScaledDotProductAttention via use_sdpa) and applies EMA smoothing before crossing the abs_threshold.
nodes.languageNotes: Honest ruvector-attention integration: when use_sdpa is true, each price level is encoded as a [size_log, side_sign, depth_idx, 1.0] vector and the attention-weighted context's sign dimension becomes the signed imbalance.

nodes.name: AttentionScalperConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the scalper: top-N depth, geometric level_decay, ema_alpha smoothing, abs_threshold, contract quantity, strategy_name, and the use_sdpa toggle that switches to ruvector ScaledDotProductAttention.

nodes.name: AttentionScalper
nodes.summary: Stateful per-symbol scalper that maintains yes/no level books, recomputes the imbalance (geometric or SDPA) on every BookSnapshot, smooths via EMA, and emits a YES or NO Intent when |smoothed_imbalance| crosses abs_threshold.

nodes.name: sdpa_imbalance
nodes.summary: Computes signed book imbalance via ruvector_attention::ScaledDotProductAttention; encodes each level as a 4-d vector, queries with a fixed pressure vector, and returns the sign dimension of the attention-weighted context.

nodes.name: update_snapshot
nodes.summary: Ingests one BookSnapshot, appends the level to yes/no buffers, truncates each side to the configured depth, computes raw imbalance (SDPA or geometric), and EMA-smooths it into per-symbol state.

nodes.name: maybe_emit
nodes.summary: Throttled emitter: if the EMA-smoothed imbalance magnitude crosses abs_threshold and the event seq has advanced, returns a Buy YES or Buy NO Intent sized by config.quantity with edge_bps proportional to the imbalance.

nodes.name: coherence_arb.rs
nodes.summary: Cross-market coherence arbitrage strategy: watches operator-configured (reference, mirror) Kalshi pairs and emits a Buy YES on the cheaper side when its mid diverges from the reference by more than min_divergence_bps.

nodes.name: CoherenceArbConfig
nodes.summary: Operator-supplied (reference, mirror) symbol pairs, divergence threshold in basis points, fractional Kelly, bankroll, and strategy attribution name.

nodes.name: CoherenceArb
nodes.summary: Stateful arbitrage strategy that maintains the latest YES-mid for every configured symbol and emits Buy-YES Intents on the divergent leg when prices fall out of coherence.

nodes.name: try_arb_for
nodes.summary: For a given symbol whose mid just updated, walks the configured pair list and returns a Buy-YES Intent on whichever leg now trades more than min_divergence_bps below its partner.

nodes.name: coherence_bridge.rs
nodes.summary: Thin bridge that wires neural-trader-coherence's CoherenceGate into the Strategy -> Intent -> RiskGate -> Order pipeline; re-exports the gate types and exposes a CoherenceChecker that fails closed when the gate errors so internal failures never authorize actuation.

nodes.name: CoherenceChecker
nodes.summary: Pre-order coherence wrapper around any CoherenceGate impl; check() returns Pass(intent) only when allow_act is true, otherwise Block with the decision (and any internal error is folded into a defensive Block).

nodes.name: CoherenceOutcome
nodes.summary: Two-variant enum returned by CoherenceChecker::check: Pass(Intent) or Block{intent, decision}.

nodes.name: simple_context
nodes.summary: Helper that builds a GateContext with sensible defaults for a single intent so callers without a full graph projection can still exercise the gate in paper-trading flows.

nodes.name: ev_kelly.rs
nodes.summary: Expected-Value Kelly strategy for binary Kalshi contracts: external probability prior `p` against market mid `m` cents drives `kelly = (p - m/100) / (1 - m/100)`, sized by a conservative kelly_fraction (default 0.25) and the intent's confidence, then converted into contract count at the current ask.

nodes.name: ExpectedValueKellyConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration carrying kelly_fraction, bankroll_cents, min_edge_bps (defensive pre-RiskGate filter), and attribution name.

nodes.name: ExpectedValueKelly
nodes.summary: Stateful per-symbol EV-Kelly strategy: stores externally supplied priors (clamped to [0.01, 0.99]) and the latest mid, emits at most one Intent per event kind via maybe_emit when the computed edge clears min_edge_bps.

nodes.name: maybe_emit
nodes.summary: Computes Kelly fraction from prior vs mid, applies kelly_fraction and confidence, converts the resulting bankroll fraction into a contract count, and emits a Buy YES or Buy NO Intent if edge_bps clears the configured floor.

nodes.name: intent.rs
nodes.summary: Canonical venue-agnostic Intent struct and its Action / Side enums; this is the type every strategy emits and every downstream stage (CoherenceChecker, RiskGate, venue adapter) consumes.

nodes.name: Action
nodes.summary: Two-variant enum (Buy / Sell) capturing whether an Intent opens or closes a position.

nodes.name: Side
nodes.summary: Binary contract side enum (Yes / No) — distinct from neural_trader_core::Side which is Bid/Ask for limit orders.

nodes.name: Intent
nodes.summary: Strategy intent struct: canonical symbol_id, Yes/No side, Buy/Sell action, limit price in Kalshi cents, quantity, edge in basis points, model confidence in [0,1], and a static strategy attribution string.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the L6 strategy runtime: declares the six submodules (attention_scalper, coherence_arb, coherence_bridge, ev_kelly, intent, risk), re-exports the public surface, and defines the venue-agnostic `Strategy` trait that all concrete strategies implement.

nodes.name: Strategy
nodes.summary: Two-method strategy trait: name() for attribution and on_event(&mut self, &MarketEvent) -> Option<Intent>; implementers return at most one Intent per event so composites can stream follow-ups.

nodes.name: risk.rs
nodes.summary: Mandatory RiskGate sitting between every strategy Intent and the venue adapter: enforces non-positive quantity, price-range, daily-loss kill (3% default), edge threshold (300 bps default), hard cash check, single-position cap (10%), cluster concentration (40%), and the KALSHI_ENABLE_LIVE env flag before approving an order.
nodes.languageNotes: Cheapest checks first; failures return RejectReason variants distinguishing InsufficientCash from PositionTooLarge so operators can debug rejections.

nodes.name: Position
nodes.summary: Open-position record (symbol_id, side, quantity, avg_price_cents) with a notional_cents() helper used by cluster accounting.

nodes.name: PortfolioState
nodes.summary: Snapshot of cash, starting cash, day P&L, open positions and symbol->cluster map fed into RiskGate::evaluate; exposes total_notional_cents and cluster_notional_cents helpers.

nodes.name: RiskConfig
nodes.summary: Hard risk limits: max_position_frac (0.10), max_daily_loss_frac (0.03), min_edge_bps (300), max_cluster_frac (0.40), and require_live_flag toggle gating real-money orders behind KALSHI_ENABLE_LIVE=1.

nodes.name: RiskDecision
nodes.summary: Two-variant outcome enum (Approve(Intent) / Reject{reason, intent}) returned by RiskGate::evaluate.

nodes.name: RejectReason
nodes.summary: Eight-variant rejection-reason enum: EdgeTooThin, PositionTooLarge, DailyLossKill, ClusterConcentration, LiveTradingDisabled, InsufficientCash, NonPositiveQuantity, PriceOutOfRange.

nodes.name: RiskGate
nodes.summary: Stateless RiskGate that runs the seven check tiers in order against a PortfolioState and approves or rejects each Intent; closing sells are always allowed so positions can be exited after the daily-loss kill trips.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Core gate routine: runs sanity, daily-loss kill, edge floor, cash check, single-position cap, cluster concentration, and live-flag check in cheapest-first order and returns Approve or a specific RejectReason.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for the WASM binding crate; configures cdylib output, wasm-bindgen/serde-wasm-bindgen/console_error_panic_hook, and depends on neural-trader-core / coherence / replay for the bindings exposed to @ruvector/neural-trader-wasm.

nodes.name: Dockerfile.test

nodes.name: MarketEventWasm
nodes.summary: wasm-bindgen wrapper around neural_trader_core::MarketEvent: exposes getter/setter properties for every field, hex round-trip for the 16-byte hashes, and to_json/from_json helpers.

nodes.name: GraphDeltaWasm

nodes.name: GateConfigWasm
nodes.summary: WASM wrapper around neural_trader_coherence::GateConfig with getter/setter pairs for every threshold so JavaScript can configure the regime-adaptive coherence gate.

nodes.name: GateContextWasm
nodes.summary: WASM wrapper around neural_trader_coherence::GateContext; constructor accepts the partition_hash as a hex string and the regime as a RegimeLabelWasm enum, with to_inner() to materialize the native GateContext on demand.

nodes.name: ThresholdGateWasm
nodes.summary: WASM wrapper around neural_trader_coherence::ThresholdGate; `evaluate` consumes a GateContextWasm and returns a CoherenceDecisionWasm so JS callers can drive the gate end-to-end.

nodes.name: CoherenceDecisionWasm
nodes.summary: WASM wrapper around CoherenceDecision exposing the four permission booleans, diagnostic values, all_allowed/fully_blocked convenience flags, and to_json for JS-side logging.

nodes.name: ReplaySegmentWasm
nodes.summary: WASM wrapper around neural_trader_replay::ReplaySegment exposing the core ids, time range, and to_json/from_json round-trip for JS callers.

nodes.name: ReservoirStoreWasm
nodes.summary: WASM wrapper around neural_trader_replay::ReservoirStore; exposes new/len/is_empty plus maybe_write (gate-aware) and retrieve_by_symbol so JS callers can drive the bounded gate-guarded memory store from the browser.

nodes.name: node-smoke.mjs
nodes.summary: Node 20 smoke test that loads the wasm-pack-built @ruvector/neural-trader-wasm module and asserts every public export (init, version, healthCheck, MarketEventWasm round-trip, GateConfigWasm, ThresholdGateWasm gate evaluation, ReservoirStoreWasm) behaves as the Rust crate documents.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml

nodes.name: embeddings.sql

nodes.name: mod.rs

nodes.name: AttentionType

nodes.name: Attention

nodes.name: softmax_inplace

nodes.name: mod.rs

nodes.name: scalar.rs
nodes.summary: Scalar (non-SIMD) implementations of vector distance metrics — euclidean, cosine, hamming, jaccard, minkowski, canberra, bray-curtis — used as the portable fallback path for the extension.

nodes.name: euclidean_distance
nodes.summary: Computes the L2 distance between two equal-length f32 slices.

nodes.name: euclidean_distance_squared
nodes.summary: Returns the squared L2 distance, avoiding the sqrt for ranking-only comparisons.

nodes.name: cosine_distance
nodes.summary: Computes 1 - cosine similarity with explicit zero-norm guards for ANN search.

nodes.name: hamming_distance_f32
nodes.summary: Counts component-wise mismatches between two f32 vectors using a small epsilon for float equality.

nodes.name: jaccard_distance
nodes.summary: Jaccard distance computed via min/max sums suitable for sparse-like f32 vectors.

nodes.name: minkowski_distance
nodes.summary: Generalized Lp distance parameterized by p, the unifying form of Euclidean and Manhattan.

nodes.name: canberra_distance
nodes.summary: Canberra distance weighted by absolute magnitudes, robust to scale differences.

nodes.name: bray_curtis_distance
nodes.summary: Bray-Curtis dissimilarity used for compositional/abundance vectors.

nodes.name: graphsage.rs
nodes.summary: GraphSAGE layer implementation with neighbor sampling, configurable aggregators, and linear-transform/forward routines that back the GNN SQL functions in the extension.

nodes.name: GraphSAGELayer
nodes.summary: Trainable GraphSAGE layer with mean/pool/lstm aggregators, neighbor sampling, and stochastic-gradient update support.

nodes.name: with_aggregator
nodes.summary: Constructs a GraphSAGELayer for a given aggregator variant and dimensionality, initializing weight matrices.

nodes.name: sample_neighbors
nodes.summary: Uniformly samples up to fanout neighbors from a node's adjacency list with replacement when sparse.

nodes.name: linear_transform
nodes.summary: Applies the layer's weight matrix to a concatenated feature vector to produce the next-layer embedding.

nodes.name: forward_with_sampling
nodes.summary: End-to-end GraphSAGE forward pass: samples neighbors, aggregates, concatenates self+neighbor, and applies the linear transform plus activation.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Applies an SGD-style weight update from a gradient and learning rate.

nodes.name: ast.rs
nodes.summary: Complete AST type hierarchy for the embedded SPARQL dialect: queries, graph patterns, RDF terms, expressions, aggregates, solution modifiers, and update operations parsed and lowered by the graph subsystem.

nodes.name: SparqlQuery
nodes.summary: Top-level SPARQL query AST node combining the form (SELECT/CONSTRUCT/ASK/DESCRIBE), dataset, where pattern, and solution modifiers.

nodes.name: GraphPattern
nodes.summary: Enum of SPARQL graph patterns (BGP, Join, Optional, Union, Filter, Bind, Minus, Service, Graph) forming the algebraic core of query evaluation.

nodes.name: PropertyPath
nodes.summary: Property-path enum covering predicate, inverse, sequence, alternative, and Kleene-star operators used in BGP traversal.

nodes.name: RdfTerm
nodes.summary: RDF term type spanning IRIs, blank nodes, and literals with helpers for term-kind classification.

nodes.name: Expression
nodes.summary: SPARQL expression enum covering literals, variables, arithmetic, comparison, logical, function calls, and built-ins (REGEX, BOUND, etc).

nodes.name: Aggregate
nodes.summary: SPARQL aggregate function set (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, GROUP_CONCAT, SAMPLE) with DISTINCT flagging.

nodes.name: UpdateOperation
nodes.summary: SPARQL Update operation enum (INSERT, DELETE, LOAD, CLEAR, CREATE, DROP, COPY, MOVE, ADD) covering the full update surface.

nodes.name: ruvector_healing_history

nodes.name: ruvector_healing_history_since

nodes.name: ruvector_healing_history_for_strategy

nodes.name: ruvector_healing_trigger

nodes.name: ruvector_healing_execute
nodes.summary: Executes a healing strategy by name and returns success/diagnostic metadata.

nodes.name: ruvector_healing_configure
nodes.summary: Updates healing configuration parameters (enable flags, cooldown, max retries) from SQL with validation.

nodes.name: ruvector_healing_get_config
nodes.summary: Returns the current healing configuration as a JSON document.

nodes.name: ruvector_healing_strategies
nodes.summary: Lists available healing strategies with descriptions and applicable problem types.

nodes.name: ruvector_healing_thresholds
nodes.summary: Returns the configured detection thresholds keyed by problem type.

nodes.name: ruvector_healing_set_thresholds
nodes.summary: Persists updated detection thresholds, validating range and emitting an audit entry.

nodes.name: ruvector_healing_problem_types
nodes.summary: Enumerates the problem-type taxonomy understood by the healing engine.

nodes.name: lorentz.rs

nodes.name: LorentzModel
nodes.summary: Marker struct grouping the Lorentz-model operations (dot, distance, Poincare conversions) as associated functions.

nodes.name: minkowski_dot

nodes.name: RuHnswSharedState

nodes.name: RuHnswParallelScanDesc

nodes.name: ParallelScanCoordinator

nodes.name: scan_partition

nodes.name: ruhnsw_estimate_parallel_workers

nodes.name: merge_knn_results_tournament

nodes.name: execute_parallel_scan

nodes.name: evaluate_graph_pattern

nodes.name: evaluate_bgp

nodes.name: minus_solutions

nodes.name: filter_solutions
nodes.summary: Filters a solution sequence by evaluating the SPARQL filter expression against each binding.

nodes.name: apply_modifiers
nodes.summary: Applies result-set modifiers (ORDER BY, DISTINCT, OFFSET, LIMIT) to the projected solution sequence.

nodes.name: evaluate_expression
nodes.summary: Recursively evaluates a SPARQL expression tree (literals, variables, function calls, arithmetic, logical, comparison) yielding an RDF term.

nodes.name: evaluate_binary_op
nodes.summary: Evaluates binary operators in SPARQL expressions including arithmetic, comparison, and logical operations with type coercion.

nodes.name: execute_construct
nodes.summary: Executes a CONSTRUCT query by evaluating the WHERE pattern and substituting bindings into the template triples.

nodes.name: execute_describe
nodes.summary: Executes a DESCRIBE query, returning all triples mentioning the targeted resources from the store.

nodes.name: SparqlContext
nodes.summary: Execution context bundling the triple store, base IRI, and namespace prefixes for a SPARQL evaluation session.

nodes.name: QueryResult
nodes.summary: Enumeration of possible SPARQL query result kinds (Select, Construct, Ask, Describe, Update).

nodes.summary: Graph node representing a partition with active/free status and incident-edge tracking.

nodes.name: Edge

nodes.name: GraphError
nodes.summary: Error enum for coherence-graph operations covering capacity, missing-node, missing-edge, and arithmetic-overflow cases.

nodes.name: add_node
nodes.summary: Adds a partition node, reusing freed slots when available or growing the node vector, enforcing capacity bounds.

nodes.name: remove_node

nodes.name: remove_edge_by_index

nodes.name: NeighborIter

nodes.name: free_pages
nodes.summary: Returns a 2^order-page block to the allocator and merges it with its buddy when the buddy is also free, walking up the order tree.

nodes.name: coalesce
nodes.summary: Recursive helper that merges a freed block with its buddy if the buddy is also free, promoting the merged region to a higher order.

nodes.name: find_first_free

nodes.name: free_page_count

tour.title: Project Intent & Manifesto
tour.description: Start with the canonical project pitch. README.md is the 5.5K-line overview that frames RuVector as a self-learning vector + graph + LLM operating system (GNN that learns from queries, SONA self-optimizer, DiskANN, ColBERT, Matryoshka, hybrid sparse+dense, Cypher, local LLMs). CLAUDE.md is the in-repo playbook for agents working in the tree, and CHANGELOG.md captures what has actually shipped through the 0.1.x and hailo-backend releases — together they tell you what the workstation install is supposed to deliver and at what maturity.

tour.title: The Installer's Contract
tour.description: `install.sh` is the user-facing front door this slice is about: a one-line bootstrap that installs Rust via rustup if missing, then runs `cargo install ruvector-cli` (producing the Rust binaries) plus `npm install -g ruvector` (the JS wrapper). The Cargo workspace manifest declares which member crates exist and the shared dependency versions, so reading the two together tells you exactly which artifacts land on disk and from where.
tour.languageLesson: Cargo workspaces let multiple crates share one Cargo.lock and one target/ directory. `cargo install <crate>` reads the crate's [[bin]] entries from its own Cargo.toml and compiles each as a standalone binary into ~/.cargo/bin — that's how a single workspace publishes both `ruvector` and `ruvector-mcp-server`.

tour.title: What `cargo install ruvector-cli` Actually Builds
tour.description: The ruvector-cli crate manifest is the precise specification of what gets compiled and installed. It declares two binaries — `ruvector` and `ruvector-mcp-server` — pulls in ~60 dependencies (clap, tokio, sqlx, axum, indicatif), and gates optional features. After this step you can predict exactly which executables show up in `~/.cargo/bin` and what optional capabilities the build can toggle.
tour.languageLesson: Cargo `[[bin]]` tables are how one crate publishes multiple binaries; each entry maps a name to a `path` source file. Feature flags in `[features]` let downstream installers opt into heavier code paths (e.g. postgres, hailo) without bloating the default build.

tour.title: Binary Entry Point & Command Dispatch
tour.description: `main.rs` is the literal entry point of the `ruvector` binary you just installed: it defines the top-level clap Cli/Commands enum and dispatches every subcommand to a handler in the `cli/` module. `config.rs` is the very first thing those handlers consult — a hierarchical Config / DatabaseConfig / CliConfig / McpConfig loaded from TOML and overridden by env vars. Together they answer 'when I type `ruvector …`, what runs and how does it find its settings?'
tour.languageLesson: Clap's derive API turns a Rust enum into a full argument parser at compile time: each variant becomes a subcommand and its fields become named flags. The dispatcher is a single `match` on the enum — adding a verb means adding a variant and one match arm, nothing more.

tour.title: The CLI Command Surface — What You'll Actually Type
tour.description: These modules implement the verbs a user runs after install. `commands.rs` owns the core vector-DB ops (create, insert, search, info, benchmark, export, import) including JSON/CSV/NPY ingestion. `graph.rs` adds the Cypher subcommands and an embedded HTTP/gRPC/GraphQL server. `format.rs` and `progress.rs` are the shared output layer (colored tables, JSON/CSV dumps, indicatif progress bars). Read this step to know which commands actually exist on the binary that just landed in your PATH.

tour.title: Self-Learning Hooks & PostgreSQL State
tour.description: RuVector's claim to fame is that it learns from how you use it. The hooks subsystem is where that happens: `hooks.rs` is a Q-learning engine over patterns, vector-embedded memories, trajectories, error sequences, and file-sequence prediction; `hooks_postgres.rs` is the pgvector-backed persistence layer; and `hooks_schema.sql` is the actual eight-table schema (`ruvector_hooks_patterns`, `_memories`, `_trajectories`, `_errors`, `_file_sequences`, `_swarm_agents`, `_swarm_edges`, `_stats`) that the install writes when you opt into the Postgres backend.
tour.languageLesson: pgvector extends Postgres with a `vector` column type and ANN operators (`<=>` cosine, `<#>` inner product, `<->` L2). It lets the hooks engine store learned memories as embeddings directly in SQL and recall them with the same WHERE-clause language used for regular columns — no separate vector store required.

tour.title: The Embedded MCP Server
tour.description: The install ships a second binary, `ruvector-mcp-server`, that exposes RuVector as a Model Context Protocol endpoint so Claude and other LLM clients can call it as a tool. `mcp_server.rs` is the binary entry point. The `mcp/` module is the implementation: `protocol.rs` defines JSON-RPC and MCP wire types; `handlers.rs` dispatches initialize / tools/list / tools/call and the underlying create_db / insert / search tool handlers; `transport.rs` provides both stdio and an axum-based SSE/HTTP server; `gnn_cache.rs` is an LRU cache of GNN forward passes that keeps tool calls fast.
tour.languageLesson: MCP rides on JSON-RPC 2.0: every request is a `{jsonrpc, id, method, params}` envelope, every response carries either a `result` or an `error`. Servers advertise capabilities in `initialize`, then expose tools via `tools/list` and execute them via `tools/call` — the same handler can be reached over stdio (for spawned subprocesses) or over SSE/HTTP (for networked clients).

tour.title: The npm Wrapper Path (`npx ruvector`)
tour.description: Beyond `cargo install`, the installer also publishes an npm package so Node users can run `npx ruvector` or `npm install -g ruvector` instead. The npm root workspace manifest declares the wrapper packages and lifecycle scripts; the user-facing npm/README documents the JS API (VectorDB class, RAG/cypher bindings) and how the package ships the WASM and the native CLI; PUBLISHING_STATUS tracks readiness of `ruvector`, `@ruvector/core`, and `@ruvector/wasm` across the three-phase rollout.

tour.title: The Library Underneath: `ruvector-core` Public API
tour.description: Both the CLI and the npm wrapper sit on top of `ruvector-core`. `lib.rs` is the crate root and the highest-fan-out node in the graph — it declares every top-level module and re-exports the public API. `types.rs` defines the vocabulary (DistanceMetric, VectorEntry, SearchQuery, SearchResult, DbOptions, HnswConfig, QuantizationConfig). `vector_db.rs` is the high-level façade — a VectorDB type that composes storage + index + quantization into one CRUD-and-search object. This is the API surface the CLI command handlers in Step 5 actually call into.
tour.languageLesson: Rust's `lib.rs` plays the role of both the module tree root and the public-API gate: anything not `pub` from `lib.rs` is invisible to other crates. The pattern of re-exporting (`pub use module::Thing`) keeps the implementation modular while presenting consumers with a flat, stable surface.

tour.title: Vector-DB Primitives — How Search Actually Runs
